{"task": {"id": "I_kwDOVRkquM8AAAABZaStuQ", "item_id": "PVTI_lAHOAHSLSM4Bn_T5zhDBm9c", "project_id": "PVT_kwHOAHSLSM4Bn_T5", "number": 39, "title": "Implement WRIO-controlled PPU H/V counter latching and acknowledgement", "body": "## Problem

At baseline `9dedbee9a1baaa7d3d80bfd54a77046cfc2b9b03`, WRIO and the PPU counter latch are disconnected:

- `SystemBus::new` initializes every CPU I/O byte to zero; `$4201` writes only store the byte (`crates/snes-core/src/machine.rs:128–150,370–397`).
- SLHV `$2137` unconditionally captures counters (`crates/snes-core/src/ppu.rs:182–195`).
- STAT78 `$213F` unconditionally clears the latch flag (`ppu.rs:245–250`).

This omits the CPU-controlled latch gate and falling-edge capture. It also leaves existing tests unable to distinguish enabled from disabled software latching. The latest assessment explicitly identifies this gap as the next bounded correction. No open Issue is listed in the supplied context.

## Expected outcome

Implement one coherent WRIO/counter-latch behavior across CPU I/O and PPU register access.

The target register contract is:

1. WRIO `$4201` resets to `$FF`. Initialization must not simulate a falling-edge latch.
2. A WRIO bit-7 transition from 1 to 0 captures H/V counters and sets the latch flag. Repeated low writes, rising edges and changes confined to other bits do not capture counters.
3. Reading SLHV `$2137` captures counters only while WRIO bit 7 is high. While low, the held counters remain unchanged. Preserve the existing CPU open-bus return independently of whether capture occurs.
4. OPHCT/OPVCT `$213C/$213D` read held counter values through independent low/high selectors. Capturing counters does not reset those selectors.
5. Reading STAT78 `$213F` resets both selectors. With WRIO bit 7 high, it returns the latch flag and then acknowledges it. With bit 7 low, bit 6 reports set and reading does not acknowledge the flag. A rising WRIO edge alone does not clear the flag or held values.

Authoritative reference targets are [Anomie's Register Doc, revision 1157](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gilligan/snesdev/master/docs/snes_registers.txt), entries **4201 WRIO**, **2137 SLHV**, **213C/213D OPHCT/OPVCT** and **213F STAT78**, and the corresponding register descriptions in [Fullsnes](https://problemkaputt.de/fullsnes.htm). Repository reference versions and hashes are recorded in [Issue #35 validation](https://github.com/takahirox/snes-rust/blob/9dedbee9a1baaa7d3d80bfd54a77046cfc2b9b03/docs/issue-35-validation.md#evidence-and-event-terminology).

**Source-verification prerequisite:** this planning pass inspected only repository evidence; the complete WRIO-specific reference entries were unavailable locally and were not fetched. Confirm the target rules against those entries, particularly reset and low-level STAT78 behavior, before encoding expectations. Record precise supporting sections and correct any disagreement with evidence. Earlier test behavior is not authority. Documentation or tests alone do not complete this implementation Issue.

## Context and reproduction

A focused reproduction should run ordinary timed bus accesses:

1. Write WRIO high and capture position A through SLHV.
2. Advance the raster and write WRIO low at position B. Expected: B replaces A; currently no capture occurs.
3. Advance again and read SLHV while WRIO remains low. Expected: B remains held; currently another capture occurs.
4. Read STAT78 repeatedly while low, release WRIO high, then read STAT78 twice. Check the source-confirmed acknowledgement sequence and independent counter-read selectors.

Existing evidence requiring preservation or correction:

- `ppu::tests::counters_hold_the_latched_position_and_keep_independent_read_flipflops` checks held values and selectors but has no WRIO gate.
- `machine::hdma_phase_tests::payload_samples_at_service_plus_four_and_commits_at_plus_eight` checks direct/indirect reverse-HDMA SLHV sampling at modeled dot 279. Preserve that assertion with an enabled gate and add disabled-gate controls. Its four/eight-clock phases remain model conventions, as [Issue #35 documents](https://github.com/takahirox/snes-rust/blob/9dedbee9a1baaa7d3d80bfd54a77046cfc2b9b03/docs/issue-35-validation.md).
- `machine::dma_tests::hdma_accessible_descriptors_use_fetched_value_and_acknowledge` assumes zero RDIO after construction. Explicitly initialize WRIO for its zero-descriptor case if reset changes; retain termination, acknowledgement, pointer and timing assertions.

Scope: WRIO reset/bit-7 control, software and falling-edge capture, STAT78 acknowledgement, and shared register routing through existing system-bank mirrors and B-bus reads. Retain the current scheduler and counter conversion, clearly labeled as model behavior.

Non-goals and remaining `ppu-ports` work: physical controller/light-gun latch inputs, general RDIO external-pin emulation, exact counter conversion around long dots and field boundaries, electrical open-bus accuracy, active-display VRAM read restrictions, OAM/CGRAM access corruption and access-boundary timing. Raster rendering, interlace/overscan, PAL and DMA startup/alignment remain separate work. This Issue does not complete `ppu-ports`, `bus` or `scheduler`, or change other inventory statuses.

## Pre-merge acceptance

- [ ] Record source-confirmed reset, edge, gate, flag and selector semantics with reference version/section citations. Resolve any contradictory earlier expectations explicitly; do not preserve unsupported behavior to satisfy old tests.
- [ ] Implement the confirmed behavior through the existing CPU/PPU register paths. Cover `Machine::new` and `Machine::reset`; retain SRAM preservation and unrelated I/O semantics.
- [ ] Add original numerical tests covering all four old/new bit-7 combinations, unrelated-bit changes, repeated captures, enabled/disabled SLHV, repeated low/high STAT78 reads, selector reset, and captures between low/high counter reads. Exercise H and V bit 8 and mask floating bits appropriately.
- [ ] Add natural-scheduler vectors using timed CPU bus operations without injected raster/counter/latch state. Check a write or read crossing a scanline boundary captures at the existing access-completion boundary; distinguish this convention from independently verified hardware timing. Exercise `$00/$3F/$80/$BF` mirrors and non-system-bank controls.
- [ ] Preserve the direct/indirect reverse-HDMA dot-279 sampling assertion under an enabled gate; add low-gate retention cases. Preserve existing DMA/HDMA progression and side-effect assertions, including the explicitly initialized zero-RDIO descriptor.
- [ ] Add an original CPU-executed LoROM guest in `crates/snes-core/tests/ppu_counter_latch.rs`. Guest instructions must initialize WRIO, synchronize through executed registers, exercise capture/gating/acknowledgement, and publish numerical WRAM results. The host supplies only the generated ROM and observes results. Require STP plus a success marker within 100,000 instructions and fewer than three frame wraps. Document original MIT code/data and in-memory build provenance in `tests/roms/PROVENANCE.md`; acquire no commercial ROM or firmware.
- [ ] Demonstrate focused behavioral failures against the baseline and passes after implementation. Update README and a focused validation record with actual commands/results and remaining uncertainty.
- [ ] Pass these Rust and source-built hardware checks from the repository root:

```sh
cargo fmt --all -- --check
cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings
cargo test --workspace --locked
cargo test --locked -p snes-core --test ppu_counter_latch
python3 tools/make-fixture.py .cache/smoke.bin
cmp tests/roms/smoke.bin .cache/smoke.bin
python3 tools/build-test-tools.py --spc
python3 tools/hardware-tests.py \
  --ca65 "$PWD/.cache/tools/cc65/bin/ca65" \
  --ld65 "$PWD/.cache/tools/cc65/bin/ld65" \
  --spcasm "$PWD/.cache/tools/spcasm/target/release/spcasm"
python3 tools/ppu-test.py --bass "$PWD/.cache/tools/bass-untech/bass/out/bass-untech"
```

- [ ] Pass the existing browser regressions using the audited source-built games:

```sh
python3 tools/build-cleared-games.py
python3 tools/build-cleared-games.py
npm --prefix web ci
npm --prefix web run build
(cd web && npx playwright install chromium)
npm --prefix web test -- --grep-invert '301 seconds'
```

Preserve fixture pins, licensing notices, game hashes, replay inputs and gameplay/audio assertions. Follow README toolchain prerequisites. Record failures and unperformed checks honestly; limited passes establish neither full hardware accuracy nor commercial compatibility.

## Optional validation

None.

## Required post-merge verification

None.
